snippet.title: [Out Nov 13]Fail the Beat, Pierce Your Friend: Violent Rhythm-Action Game PIERCING
snippet.description:
PIERCING is a rhythm-action game where you smash every panel to the beat. Fail, and the Contract forces you to give your childhood friend a piercing.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4348420/_/
